title: Coordinator lease renewal and self-fencing on the active main
goal: An active coordinator holds an expiring lease and fences itself when renewals stop, so an unreachable old main stops within the horizon
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: The running coordinator renews its lease through standby acks and calls selfFenceCoordinator when renewal fails past the lease (tests)
Lease 0 is not authoritative after a relocation: an active coordinator whose epoch was superseded, or that was promoted with other bases enrolled, refuses effects until a lease is armed (tests)
Store.assertActiveCoordinator passes maxSeenCoordinatorEpoch, baseId and mainBaseId to the authority check (test across Store and coordinator-authority)
The horizon wait uses a monotonic clock; then the unplanned path may drop the mandatory old-host confirmation where every unrevoked peer acked
validation: Directed regressions in the named test files
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress
